name: Ero Manga! H mo Manga mo Step-up ♪
original_name: えろまんが！Hもマンガもステップアップ♪
source:
Okazaki Kazuya, a college student on the brink of graduation who's deeply passionate about erotic manga, finds himself jobless while his peers secure positions. Distracted by his hobby, he hasn't done any job hunting. One day, while browsing Comic Bottom, a mediocre erotic manga magazine, he spots an ad for an editorial position at the magazine, which is in dire need of a refresh.
Seeing this as his chance, Kazuya applies and secures the position. However, he soon discovers that the editorial department is on the brink of collapse, with quirky and challenging coworkers and an unmotivated editor-in-chief. Despite the chaos, he's determined to succeed in the industry he loves and help revitalize the magazine.

[Condensed from the [url=http://clockup.net/eromanga/]official site[/url]]
translation:
大学即将毕业的冈崎一也对色情漫画充满热情，却眼看同龄人都找到了工作，只有自己无业。他沉迷爱好，根本没有求职。一天，他翻看平庸的色情漫画杂志《Comic Bottom》时，发现杂志社正在招聘编辑，而且急需改革。
一也认为机会来了，便申请并获得职位。然而，他很快发现编辑部已经濒临崩溃：同事古怪又难以相处，主编也毫无干劲。尽管一片混乱，他仍决心在自己热爱的行业取得成功，帮助振兴这本杂志。

[改写自[url=http://clockup.net/eromanga/]官方网站[/url]]
